No actions this turn.

Before I write anything, a note on size. This is bigger than a single design. It has at least three parts that each need building and testing:

- the page a visitor lands on when they scan, which plays the story and remembers their language
- the way volunteers upload or replace a recording without help
- the automatic clean-up that levels and trims each recording before it goes live

None of it exists yet. So rather than one large document, I'll set it out as a short roadmap of stages, each usable on its own. A sensible order is the visitor player first, then volunteer uploads, then the clean-up. We'd settle the details of each stage when we reach it, and the roadmap is the written record. If you'd rather have one full design document instead, say so.

One thing I still don't know will shape that roadmap: what's prompting the guide now, and what would make you say it's working a year from now?
